description: This Java class 'RetransmissionHandler' manages retransmission logic for MQTT messages, including exponential backoff, jitter, attempt counting, and scheduling retries using Netty's EventLoop.

classes.name: RetransmissionHandler
classes.description: Handles retransmission logic for MQTT messages with exponential backoff, jitter, and retry attempts.

methods.name: setOriginalMessage
methods.description: Sets the original MQTT message and extracts its message ID for logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the retransmission process using the provided Netty EventLoop.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Schedules the next retransmission attempt with exponential backoff and jitter.

methods.name: isDup
methods.description: Determines if the MQTT message should be marked as duplicate for retransmission.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the retransmission process and cancels any scheduled retries.
